description: Polymarket prediction markets matching a text query, or the top markets by 24-hour volume when no query is given. Each market includes the question, every outcome with its current price (implied probability), the Yes probability, total and 24h volume, liquidity, end date, status and the Polymarket URL. Source: Polymarket Gamma API. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

active.description: true returns only open markets (default); false includes closed and resolved ones

q.description: Words to search in market questions and event titles (optional; without it the result is the top markets by 24h volume)
